thread:
auditor_sam: Hi all — during our SOC2/ISO evidence review we have a couple of follow-ups on KMS custody and an emergency rotation scenario. Need: 1) signed HSM attestation (vendor-signed) for any keys using HSM-backed HSM/EKM, 2) chain-of-custody for keys moved between regions in last 6 months, 3) evidence of emergency-rotation invocation (if ever), 4) vuln-triage notes if any ekm-proxy CVEs touched keys. ETA?

lina: I can pull HSM attestation PDF from vendor portal (Thales/Luna) and the internal import manifest. Question: do you need the vendor-signed PDF or a screenshot + S3 archived copy?

auditor_sam: Vendor-signed PDF is preferred. Also include the SHA256 of the PDF in the bundle so we can verify integrity.

jason: For cross-region moves we have a migration manifest in S3: s3://redwood-prod-security/ekm/migrations/2025/ that lists source/dest, operator, and SSM runbook commit. I can export a CSV and add operator sign-off entries.

ops_ryan: Emergency rotations: we've had one driven incident last year (2025-09-12) where a service account key was suspected. We executed the emergency playbook and rotated envelope keys. I can provide the incident ticket (INC-5421), timeline, and the rotation audit (CloudTrail + SIEM hashes).

devsec: On the vuln front: ekm-proxy had a low-severity dependency vuln (CVE-2025-9999) — we patched the proxy on 2025-09-13, no evidence of key material export. Records: PR https://git.redwood/sec-infra/pull/589, commit 3b4f1e9, and the vuln-triage notes live in Jira SEC-2710. I'll attach a signed triage summary.

auditor_sam: Good. For the emergency rotation evidence we need: CloudTrail events for ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey calls (3 events), SIEM integrity manifest (hash + timestamp) and the operator approval log (who triggered rotation). Also a signed PDF of the playbook snapshot with version.

lina: Splunk query we used to pull exports: ```index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:kms (eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=RotateKey) | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, resources | head 50``` Will include 3 example events per environment.

jason: HSM attestation (vendor) will be saved as (sha256): 9f2b1c... (I'll compute full hash in bundle).

infra-bot: infra-bot: Automated snapshot: created evidence-bundle SEC-2710-evidence-2026-02-10-177111 at s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/SEC-2710/177111-snapshot.zip (presigned links to follow).

ops_ryan: Also adding the chain-of-custody manifest: operator approvals are signed via our internal signing service (keysigning.redwood). We'll include the PKCS7 signatures alongside the CSV.

auditor_sam: Can you also map these artifacts to ISO controls (A.10.1, A.12.3) and SOC2 CC6? Reviewer wants a one-page mapping doc.

lina: Will produce a mapping.csv and a one-page PDF summary. Final upload ETA: 2026-02-10 EOD. I'll post presigned links and the PDF SHA256 here when done.

auditor_sam: Perfect. One last ask: please redact any full ARN account numbers in public artifacts but keep them in the raw bundle for auditor viewing.

devsec: Noted. We'll include redacted summaries for public review and full raw JSON in the presigned S3 with access controls.

infra-bot: infra-bot: evidence-bundle SEC-2710 prepared; access logs will show downloads.

auditor_sam: Thanks team — I'll check the bundle once links are posted. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :raised_hands:
